text: Hello, my name is Joseph Paul Cohen. I'm a postdoctoral fellow at Miele and the University of Montreal.
Today I'm going to introduce the Medical Imaging with Deep Learning tutorial.
This tutorial will cover the background of popular medical imaging domains such as chest x-ray and histology.
We're going to cover methods to tackle multi-modality or multi-view problems, as well as segmentation and counting tasks.
We're going to discuss issues such as incorrect feature attribution and some approaches to mitigate this issue,
as well as the use of GANs in medical imaging, as well as issues and benefits of using these methods.
The prerequisites for this tutorial are just going to be a basic knowledge of computer vision using convolutional neural networks,
machine learning concepts such as regression, gradient descent, and backpropagation.
So I hope you enjoy this tutorial.
